title: EDHOC TH_2 uses raw bytes instead of CBOR sequence per RFC 9528
description:
In python/src/lichen/crypto/edhoc.py, TH_2 is computed using raw byte concatenation:

Lines 455-457 (initiator), 691-693 (responder):
  th_2_input = g_y + h_msg1  # 64 bytes raw
  self._th_2 = _compute_th(th_2_input)

RFC 9528 Section 4.1.2 specifies TH_2 = H(G_Y, H(message_1)) as a CBOR sequence. Appendix C.1 test vectors confirm the input is 68 bytes (two 34-byte CBOR bstr items).

TH_3 and TH_4 in the same file correctly use CBOR encoding:
  th_3_input = cbor2.dumps(self._th_2) + cbor2.dumps(plaintext_2) + cred_r

Fix: Change TH_2 computation to:
  th_2_input = cbor2.dumps(g_y) + cbor2.dumps(h_msg1)

Impact: Protocol will not interoperate with RFC 9528-compliant implementations.
